channel.description: Press Releases from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission

item.title: SEC Charges Commercial Real Estate Issuer with Defrauding Investors in $120M Offering
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission charged Horizon Real Estate Partners and its senior officers with misappropriating funds and misrepresenting debt covenant compliance to institutional bondholders.

item.title: SEC Proposes Stricter Liquidity and Reporting Standards for Registered Private Funds
item.description: The Commission proposed amendments requiring quarterly reporting of leveraged loans and credit default swap exposures to enhance systemic risk monitoring.
